host/injectedEventCounts XID and clock-event counts, totals and last XID follow events injected into one real GPU through a private hostengine, and a metrics override sets how long an XID is counted
host/gpuBindUnbindEvents Unbind one idle GPU from the nvidia driver and bind it again; its series disappear and return with the bind/unbind watch on. Refuses on a host with one GPU, no idle MIG-off GPU, persistence mode on, an NVLink fabric, or a driver older than 590; needs passwordless sudo
host/migGpuLevelFields Every GPU in MIG mode with two instances of the largest profile that fits twice; the exporter defaults stay up for a minute and report GPU-level families once per physical GPU while instance-level families keep their instance series. Changes MIG on every GPU and restores it; skipped with fewer than two GPUs or a GPU without MIG; needs passwordless sudo
host/gpuLoadUtilization GPU utilization and energy follow dcgmproftester load on one GPU against the other idle GPUs; skipped with fewer than two idle GPUs
